channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Japan turns to Canadian crude as Asia feels Hormuz supply pinch
item.description: Uncertainty over crude oil supplies via the Strait of Hormuz is pushing Asian states towards Canada's TMX crude oil.

item.title: One killed in Russian missile strikes on Kyiv, day after Zelenskyy warning
item.description: Returning from the US, Zelenskyy says Ukraine's safety depends on allies’ willingness to provide anti-missile defences.

item.title: Iran war live: US launches ‘powerful’ strikes after IRGC attack on Jordan
item.description: Threat comes as Iranian media report that four Iranians were killed in joint US-Saudi attacks in Iraq.

item.title: Saudi Arabia seeks international coalition against Houthis in Red Sea
item.description: Riyadh seeks partners to safeguard shipping in Red Sea as strikes on energy tankers expand, pushing oil prices higher.

item.title: Trump threatens Iran strikes after attack on US base in Jordan
item.description: ”It’s our turn.” President Donald Trump says the US will hit Iran “very hard” following an attack on US forces in Jordan

item.description: US and Saudi forces launched coordinated airstrikes targeting Iran-backed Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF) bases

item.title: New investigation shows how an Israeli settler escaped justice
item.description: A Palestinian rights' group found that an Israeli settler killed Awdah Hathaleen but is still escaping justice.

item.title: US launches 'powerful' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
item.description: The US military called the strikes "a powerful response" to Tuesday's firing by Iran on US bases in Jordan.

item.title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war
item.description: The kingdom faces a choice of whether to keep hitting back as a deterrent or to try to de-escalate the situation.

item.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted of terror offences
item.description: Hadi Matar, 28, was convicted of attempting to help Hezbollah by attacking the British-Indian author.
